domain: Religious Law / Halakhic Tradition / Commitment System Theory
topic_summary: Analysis of the rabbinic preservation of Temple sacrifice law (Kodashim) through continuous study for ~1,900 years without performance. The kernel contest centers on whether study-without-performance constitutes genuine occupation of the commitment (study-as-exercise reading) or merely archival preservation of a defunct practice (performance-only reading). This is a D1/D4 boundary case testing whether exercising a commitment requires material instantiation or whether intellectual engagement suffices.

key_entities: Kodashim (Talmudic order on Temple sacrifice law)
Second Temple (destroyed 70 CE, ending sacrifice performance)
Rabbinic study tradition (continuous intellectual engagement 70 CE–present)
Messianic restoration expectation (theological framework for future performance)
Material sacrifice apparatus (animals, altar, priesthood — absent since 70 CE)
key_tensions: Study continuity vs performance cessation (1,900 years of intellectual engagement without material instantiation)
Commitment occupation vs symbolic archiving (whether study alone sustains the commitment or merely preserves its memory)

commitment_system_recognition.kernel_description: Temple sacrifice law as divinely commanded practice requiring specific material conditions (Temple, priesthood, ritual purity) for performance
commitment_system_recognition.authority_description: Rabbinic interpretive tradition grounded in Sinaitic revelation and chain of transmission (mesorah); legitimacy derives from fidelity to received text and precedent
commitment_system_recognition.candidate_pattern: D1/D4 boundary — study-as-exercise reading treats it as D1 (functioning drift via interpretive elaboration); performance-only reading treats it as D4 (absent drift, commitment defunct)

readings.commitment: Study of sacrifice law is itself performance of the divine command; intellectual engagement occupies the commitment in absence of material conditions
readings.authority_grounding: Talmudic principle 'study equals performance' (Menachot 110a); messianic expectation frames current study as preparation for future restoration
readings.expected_structural_delta: Zero extractiveness — study is intrinsically valuable exercise of commitment; no victim set; beneficiary is the studying community maintaining covenant fidelity

readings.commitment: Sacrifice law requires material instantiation; study without performance is archival preservation of a defunct practice, not occupation of the commitment
readings.authority_grounding: Literalist reading of biblical commandments as requiring physical performance; study is memorial activity pending restoration conditions
readings.expected_structural_delta: Commitment is dormant husk; study is low-epsilon rope (coordination mechanism for potential future performance); no current victim set but potential future victims if restoration attempted without ethical evolution

readings.commitment: Study maintains commitment in suspended state — neither full occupation nor mere archiving; preparatory exercise for messianic restoration
readings.authority_grounding: Maimonidean synthesis: study preserves knowledge for future performance while having independent value as Torah engagement
readings.expected_structural_delta: Moderate extractiveness — study extracts cognitive resources for uncertain future benefit; potential victim set includes those whose resources fund study of non-performable law

readings.commitment: Sacrifice commitment has undergone authorized transformation — prayer and study are the new instantiation, not substitutes for a suspended practice
readings.authority_grounding: Post-Temple rabbinic innovation claiming interpretive authority to transform material commandments into spiritual equivalents (Hosea 14:3 'bulls of our lips')
readings.expected_structural_delta: High extractiveness if transformation is unauthorized drift — authority structure claims power to redefine divine command; victim set includes those who hold original material performance as non-negotiable

axiom_contradictions.basis: Study-as-exercise holds that intellectual engagement alone can occupy a divine command; performance-only holds that material instantiation is definitional to the command. No single framework can hold both: either study suffices or it does not.

Symbolic transformation claims rabbinic authority to redefine the content of divine commands; performance-only denies such authority exists. These are mutually exclusive claims about interpretive legitimacy.

omegas.description: Karaite Judaism rejected rabbinic authority entirely, including study-as-performance doctrine. Does their 1,000-year parallel tradition constitute a fifth reading (rejection-as-fidelity) or confirm performance_only reading?
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory) — non-rabbinic Jewish traditions

omegas.description: Contemporary Third Temple movement attempts material restoration. If successful, does this validate performance_only reading or expose symbolic_transformation as unauthorized drift? Ethical evolution question: can animal sacrifice be restored without becoming a snare?
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 3 (Beneficiary Scan) — who benefits from restoration vs continuation of study-only status

omegas.description: Christian tradition claims sacrifice commitment was fulfilled and superseded by Christ. Is this a fifth reading of the same kernel or a different kernel entirely (Christological vs Sinaitic authority)?
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 1 (Operational Medium) — analysis operates within rabbinic framework; Christian reading may be structurally distinct kernel

omegas.description: Is this genuinely a D1/D4 boundary case or does the 1,900-year study tradition definitively resolve it as D1 (functioning drift via study-as-performance innovation)? Classification instability may reflect genuine structural ambiguity.
omegas.source: F03 (Hasty Generalization) — commitment system pattern assignment uncertain

fracture_scan.notes: F03 detected: D1/D4 pattern classification uncertain — the 1,900-year duration of study-without-performance may itself resolve the boundary case (if study tradition is stable, it is functioning D1 drift), but model lacks domain expertise to adjudicate between readings. Generated omega_d1_d4_classification to bound this uncertainty. Four readings identified as genuinely distinct and individually holdable; axiom contradictions declared for study_as_exercise/performance_only and symbolic_transformation/performance_only pairs.
